credit: Package discovery and segmentation approach: Tim Roth, Discover and Segment PHP servers with Cisco Secure Workload, https://youtu.be/OSnb8eNuJHE
purpose: Shrink who can open a connection to PHP workloads while the PHP update is scheduled.
limitation: An allowed front door can still deliver the request that reaches the bug. This file does not patch PHP and it was not sent to a cluster.

port_shape.port: [low, high], inclusive. Read from a Secure Workload policy object on 22 Oct 2026.

filters.name: PHP-Web
filters.note: Add another filter for each version you actually find, such as php#5.4.16-48.el7. Match the package name php, not php-fpm.

catch_all: After the allows above are in the workspace, a lab catch-all of Deny covers clients the explicit deny missed. Confirm the approved edge still works before any production enforce.
